scope: Read-only source/call-site inventory; no private state, provider probes, resident service inspection or activation.

classificationLegend.EXISTS-WIRED-CLI: Source and command caller exist; not runtime commissioning.
classificationLegend.EXISTS-PURE-UNWIRED: Pure library exists without the required effectful caller.
classificationLegend.EXISTS-LIBRARY-UNWIRED: Library exists but no product caller is connected.
classificationLegend.MISSING-WIRING: Identified required connection is absent in reviewed call paths; adjacent primitives may exist.
